feature_scope: frozen roi9 v2 27 ordered columns; no feature selection repeated
cv: handoff train_cv_fold 0,1,2; train rows only; fixed 27 columns
objective: equal-weight mean of three held-out fold clipped MAEs

bo.surrogate: fixed Matern 2.5 GP on normalized log parameters

evaluation_use: all non-training cohorts previously inspected; diagnostic only; no new calibration or untouched final test
selection_rule: each arm selects by training CV only; freeze all choices before non-training diagnostics
limitation: CV conditions on historically selected fixed columns; not nested feature-selection performance. Three search seeds are optimizer repetitions, not independent roads.
